build_boost_mysql_with_b2: build Boost.MySQL tests and examples using b2 with a specified toolset, C++ standard, and variant
build_boost_mysql_with_sanitizers: build Boost.MySQL with address sanitizer and undefined behavior sanitizer enabled via b2
build_boost_mysql_with_coverage: build Boost.MySQL test suite with code coverage instrumentation enabled
build_boost_mysql_with_valgrind: build Boost.MySQL integration tests with valgrind memory checking enabled
build_boost_mysql_windows_openssl: build Boost.MySQL on Windows by writing user-config.jam with OpenSSL paths for 32 and 64 bit
